Thanks Maya — this is straightforward and a good idea to validate before pilot. High-level proposal for the Nov 19 dry-run:

1) Pre-day: create a split DNS zone for test.acme.internal pointing test services to the private IPs you provided.
2) SRE: stand up a temporary private CA or use your ACME test issuer. We'll use short-lived leaf certs (45m TTL) to exercise rotation.
3) Redwood side: we will run a parallel proxy instance in the VPC that accepts the hostnames and performs hostname assertion using CSR challenge + signed metadata.
4) Observability: enable debug KV cache logging and token-level traces for the two test routes; we will share logs via the Drive link.

I've attached a short checklist and a sample CSR for your team to copy. Karthik — can you confirm the CSR proof path and whether we should use SAN-only certs or SAN + CN?

Jonas / Maya — quick technical notes to reduce surprises on the dry-run: 

1) CSR semantics: prefer SAN-bearing certs for the private hostnames rather than relying on CN fallback. Many client stacks (our side and some older SRE tooling) treat CN as deprecated. We will generate CSRs with the exact FQDNs in the SAN list. Example attached (csr-example.pem).

2) Short-lived cert lifecycle: 45m TTL with a 10m pre-rotation window lets us observe cache eviction and renewal edge cases. If the CA you provide supports OCSP stapling for the short-lived certs, great; otherwise we will validate by probing the KV cache entries and the raw TLS handshake.

3) Split DNS: confirm the test resolver returns private IPs for test.<your-namespace>.internal and public lookup returns NX for those names. Add an SRV record only if you need service discovery — for basic assertion flow we only need A/AAAA.

4) Fallback behaviour: Redwood's proxy will treat a failed rotation as a class-2 failure: it will attempt (a) immediate re-fetch, (b) short-circuit to configured fallback model variant, (c) if still failing, return a 503 with structured error mentioning HOST_ASSERTION_FAIL. Please confirm that SRE can accept short 503 windows during the dry-run.

5) Logs & trace IDs: we'll emit trace IDs in the format rwinf-<env>-<shorthash>. Please include these when you paste logs to the Drive link or the JIRA ticket.

I'll be on the Nov 19 window and can lead the CSR/rotation checks.

—Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
